Task: Click a hyperlink within the currently displayed simulated web content.
Expected Result: A simulated loading progress bar is displayed. The simulated web content updates to reflect the linked page. The address bar updates to the new URL. The new URL is added to a simulated browsing history.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
